719-1168-3510-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-1168-3510-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

3025-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

539-3821-4679-5256-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-5256-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat

4289-4770-5295-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5571-7666-8095--6.description:
Use Bilbo, Luckwearer // Burglar's Plot to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2097-4559-5147-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
2097-4559-5147-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Jolene.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

967-5147-5220-7855--180.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Goblin, Orc or Army.
967-5147-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

1409-6463-6751.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve both Meticulous Artisan triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2150-2281-6797.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2438-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2438-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1753-2366-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2366-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2191-2474-4416.notablePrerequisites: You are able to deal damage to a creature.
2191-2474-4416.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to City on Fire, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

539-2921-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2103-4423-6701-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-6701-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-2267-6005-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2267-6005-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

2457-3129-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

856-2438-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2187-3542-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2187-3542-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Possessed Skaab and Palinchron, targeting Possessed Skaab
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Possessed Skaab and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

1418-2043-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Boommobile that is a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1418-2043-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3525-4549-6210.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Neerdiv, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

3562-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
3562-5917.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Sky Hussar token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

requires.n: Eldrazi Creature Card with MV=4, 5 or 6

2751-5637-5657--34.manaNeeded: {2}{C}{C} plus enough mana to pay for the Eldrazi spell
2751-5637-5657--34.description:
Cast an Eldrazi from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Ulalek triggers, the Eldrazi cast triggers if it has a cast ability, and Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one, and the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger.
Resolve the Eldrazi cast trigger, if applicable.
Resolve the copy of the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one, and the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

4591-4691-4971.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4591-4691-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1039-2068-2435-4920.notablePrerequisites: Apprentice Necromancer and Ornithopter of Paradise do not have summoning sickness.
1039-2068-2435-4920.description:
Activate Ornithopter of Paradise by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Ornithopter of Paradise.
Ashnod triggers, copying Teardrop Kami's ability, targeting Ornithopter of Paradise.
Resolve the first Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Ornithopter of Paradise.
Activate Ornithopter of Paradise by tapping it, adding {B}.
Resolve the second Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Ornithopter of Paradise.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Teardrop Kami.
Ashnod triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

3717-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Viridian Joiner
3717-5200.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Viridian Joiner
Repeat.
3717-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

215-3430-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
215-3430-4541.description:
Activate three Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-3883-4216.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
1651-3883-4216.description:
Activate Folio of Fancies's first ability by paying {6} and tapping it, causing you to draw three cards and create at least nine Treasure tokens due to Hullbreacher.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.

209-714-2889.description:
Blanket of Night turns all lands into Swamps.
Kormus Bell turns all swamps into creatures.
Linvala prevents your opponent' creatures from activating their abilities, including mana abilities.

2320-3368.notablePrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
You control lands that can tap to add at least {5}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
2320-3368.description:
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback cost by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Reset.
Resolve the Reset copy, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.
